**Regarding the adequacy of operating margin as a metric:**
Operating margin may not fully capture the financial health of American Express due to its unique business model, which includes significant revenue from fees and interest income rather than traditional product sales. Alternative metrics such as Return on Equity (ROE) or Return on Assets (ROA) may provide a more comprehensive view of the company's profitability and efficiency in utilizing its equity and assets.
